title: The 2026 Florida Statutes, Title XXXVII, Chapter 626, Part IX — Unfair Insurance Trade Practices
verified_how: fetched the register chapter page: 'The 2026 Florida Statutes', chapter 626, showing 'PART IX UNFAIR INSURANCE TRADE PRACTICES (ss. 626.951-626.99)' and cross-references to 'the unfair insurance trade practices provisions of s. 626.9541'.
notes: § 626.9541(1)(i) sets the unfair claim settlement practices standards and § 624.155 gives the civil remedy. Residential property claim handling has its own timetables in Chapter 627 (§§ 627.70131, 627.7015) — a human may prefer that chapter if the corpus is aimed at homeowner claims.
